About the Product Owner Online Test
The Product Owner Test is a comprehensive assessment designed to evaluate a candidate’s ability to manage product backlogs, define user stories, prioritize features, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and drive Agile product development. It ensures you hire professionals who can align product vision with business goals while delivering measurable value to customers.
